reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "add exceptions to rbac related resources for name validation by @n3wscott in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6689", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: RBAC-related resources are excepted from name validation in this release; no operator action is required.

proposed.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 adds exceptions so that RBAC-related resources are exempted from name validation.
